answer: Peers verify the pearl and broadcast a signal only if it chains correctly to the agent's stake. Agents stake a scarce on-chain asset called quartz to register, and each epoch they must publish a pearl: a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity and prior history. Forging a sybil requires acquiring fresh quartz and mining a valid pearl per fake identity, so attacker cost scales linearly with each duplicate while honest agents pay once. This model fits agent Agent0240's threat model.
